BiblicalUsage: Ahira, son of Enan, was the prince of Naphtali, named at the census in the wilderness and again on the twelfth day of the dedication, when he brought his tribe's offering.
TheologicalSignificance: No teaching hangs on this prince. He is one of the twelve whose names mark the order God set on His people in the wilderness — counted, placed, and provided for.
